institution: ABES Engineering College, Ghaziabad (code 032, not ABESIT 290)

records.title: Institution identity
records.text: ABES Engineering College, Ghaziabad, est. 2000; private self-financed, non-minority, co-ed; society: Society for Educational Excellence; AKTU college code 032.

records.title: Address and phone
records.text: 19th KM Stone, NH-09 (formerly NH-24), Ghaziabad-201009, UP. Phone 0120-7135112. Email info@abes.ac.in.

records.title: Autonomy status
records.text: Homepage states 'Autonomous College since 2025'. Mandatory Disclosure (Mar 2025) says affiliated to AKTU. Confirm governing scheme.

records.title: Accreditation
records.text: NAAC grade A; NBA accreditation for CSE, ECE, ME was listed for 01-07-2022 to 30-06-2025 (expired; renewal not verified); AICTE EOA 30-06-2024 for AY 2024-25.

records.title: Programmes offered (AICTE list, Mar 2025)
records.text: B.Tech CSE, CSE-AIML, CSE-DS, ELCE, ECE, ME; M.Tech CSE and ECE; MCA; working-professional B.Tech CSE/ECE. Closed: IT, EN, CS, CE.

records.title: Intake 2024-25
records.text: CSE 1080 UG/12 PG; AIML 180; DS 180; ECE 180 UG/6 PG; ELCE 120; ME 60; MCA 180; WP CSE 30; WP ECE 30.

records.title: Admission route
records.text: B.Tech admission as per UP Government/University norms; secondary sources say UPTAC counselling; MCA via CUET (per cut-off table). Enquiry: https://erp.abes.ac.in/onlineenquiry

records.title: Official fee pages
records.text: Fee structures are published at abes.ac.in/fee-structure.php, fee-m.tech.php and abesec.in/fee-structure.php; pages could not be retrieved.

records.title: Reported B.Tech fee (secondary)
records.text: About Rs 5.01 lakh over 4 years (counselling seats, 2025-26) per third-party portals.

records.title: Attendance rule
records.text: Student reviews report a 75% minimum; no official ABES document found. 75% is also the common AICTE/AKTU norm.

records.title: Clubs
records.text: Homepage says 11 clubs and highlights TEDx, Genero, TechFest, Utsaah. Categories on Life@ABES include yoga, literature, cultural, sports, debate, publication, environment, social activity, NSS, photography, mental well-being, tourism.

records.title: NCC unit
records.text: NCC unit established 25-Nov-2024 under 37 UP Battalion, Ghaziabad; 40 cadets; ANO Dr. Neha Singh Raghuvanshi.

records.title: Unnat Bharat Abhiyaan
records.text: UBA wing established 2-Oct-2018; five adopted villages.

records.title: Hostel capacity
records.text: Mandatory Disclosure: 4 boys' buildings (1033 seats), 3 girls' buildings (458 seats). Life@ABES: 6 boys' and 2 girls' hostels.

records.title: Library
records.text: Life@ABES: 1384 sq.m, 250 seats, KOHA, 112,334 books. Mandatory Disclosure: 115,122 books.

records.title: Sports and health
records.text: Swimming pool, floodlit stadium, multiple courts; medical room with doctor and ambulance; 'Your Dost' counselling.

records.title: Placement statistics
records.text: Homepage: 2025 highest 60 LPA, 1692 offers; 2026 glimpses: 1289 placed, 45 LPA highest, 4.50 LPA median, 80.06%.

records.title: Grievance Redressal Cell
records.text: Formed as per AICTE directions; handles grievances of students and staff; objectives include confidentiality and no victimisation; Chair is the Director; AKTU Ombudsman listed.

records.title: Anti-Ragging Committee
records.text: Published in Mandatory Disclosure with Director, Proctors, DM/SSP representatives, NGO, faculty, parents and students.

records.title: Internal Complaints Committee
records.text: Presiding Officer Dr. Bhanumati Panda; external NGO member; Registrar; student members (Mar 2025).

records.title: Equal Opportunity Facilities Cell
records.text: Nodal Officer Dr. Amita Tripathy; contact fyc@abes.ac.in.

records.title: National Anti-Ragging Helpline
records.text: 1800-180-5522 (24x7), helpline@antiragging.in.

records.title: Typical examination eligibility
records.text: Typically requires attendance threshold, dues clear and exam form; confirm with ABES/AKTU.

records.title: Typical hostel rules
records.text: Curfew, visitor restrictions, appliance bans; confirm with warden.
